supportingLine: Built for the islands, by the islands.

navy.name: Voe Navy
navy.use: Primary. Type, headers, dark UI, the one-colour mark.

teal.name: Sea Teal
teal.use: Local Wallet, loyalty, payments, success states.

amber.name: Buoy Amber
amber.use: What's On, island alerts, warnings. Ink text only.

coral.name: Lamb Coral
coral.use: Fetch, delivery, destructive and urgent states.

indigo.name: Simmer Dim
indigo.use: Spik, Aald Stories, Da Boats — heritage sections.

white.name: White
white.use: Card surfaces, reversed type on Navy.

rules: Never redraw the mark. Use the supplied files.
The open centre stays empty — no letters, no fill.
Full-colour mark on Paper or White only. On colour or photography, use the white mark.
No shadows, glows, outlines, gradients or rotation.
Below 24px use favicon.svg (single ring), not the full mark.

voice.tagline: Always “Everything Shetland, in one place.” — comma, full stop, never abbreviated or translated.
voice.dialect: Shaetlan appears in section names only (Spik, Aald Stories, Da Boats). Never in instructions or UI copy. Set plain — no italics, no quote marks, no gloss.
voice.tone: Plain, warm, specific. Say what a thing does. No hype, no exclamation marks.

contrast: Body copy: Ink on Paper, or White on Voe Navy.
Buoy Amber and Sea Teal never carry white text — use Ink.
Lamb Coral, Heather and Simmer Dim take white text at 18px+ only.
One section colour per screen, alongside Voe Navy. Never two section colours in one component.
